description: "History of the Second Massachusetts Regiment of Infantry: Beverly Ford" by Oakey is a historical account written in the late 19th century. This book provides a detailed narrative centered on the Second Massachusetts Regiment of Infantry during the Civil War, particularly focusing on the events and experiences surrounding the Battle of Beverly Ford.
